headline: SHAREHOLDERS VOTE TODAY: Energy Fuels $299M ASM Deal Creates Sole Integrated Western Mine-to-Alloy Rare Earth Champion
source_name: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU) / Australian Strategic Materials Ltd. (ASX: ASM)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU) and Australian Strategic Materials Ltd. (ASX: ASM) shareholders voted August 12, 2026 in Perth on a scheme of arrangement valuing ASM at US$299 million — the Federal Court hears final approval August 18 with implementation targeted August 28. The combined entity absorbs ASM's Dubbo polymetallic project and Korean REE metals and alloy production facility, creating the largest fully integrated rare earth 'mine-to-metal and alloy' producer outside China covering the full neodymium-praseodymium-dysprosium-terbium magnetic spectrum needed for EV motors and defense. Energy Fuels' July 27 supplementary scheme booklet updated shareholders on a separate definitive agreement to acquire German-based VAC (a major rare earth alloy and magnet producer) backed by a conditional US$725 million financing commitment from the U.S. Office of Strategic Capital — stacking three critical minerals vertical layers onto UUUU's existing White Mesa uranium and Pinyon Plain uranium milling operations. The ASM board unanimously recommended the scheme. For TSX-V investors, the deal is the clearest current example of the vertical integration strategy that Western governments are actively financing: a single Western company controlling uranium production, rare earth separation, REE metals production, and alloy manufacturing in one structure — exactly what Western defense procurement and EV supply chains need to operate independently of China.

headline: RECORD 87,867 TPD: Integra ITR Florida Canyon Posts +30% Gold in Q2 2026, Heap Leach Ore Up 45%; $111M Cash
source_name: Integra Resources Corp. (TSXV: ITR / NYSE American: ITRG)
snippet: Integra Resources Corp. (TSXV: ITR) reported Q2 2026 results on August 12 delivering its strongest operational quarter since Florida Canyon's restart: 16,379 gold ounces produced, up 30% quarter-over-quarter, on record total mining rates of 87,867 tonnes per day — above the mine plan target. Ore mining rates averaged 48,538 tonnes per day; ore stacked on the heap leach pad rose 45% to approximately 4.2 million tonnes versus Q1; processed grade improved 21% as mine sequencing entered higher-grade material; and the strip ratio fell 38% to 0.81. Cash stood at $111.1 million as of June 30, 2026. At gold above $4,400/oz, Florida Canyon's scaling heap leach economics create a clear path to free-cash-flow generation within the next two quarters — the company's most directly visible valuation re-rating catalyst. For TSX-V investors, the 30% sequential production jump on record mining rates with simultaneous grade and cost improvement is the clearest signal that the ramp is executing ahead of schedule: heap leach operations of this scale generate the most margin expansion in the $4,200–$4,500 gold range, where incremental revenue on locked-in volumes flows directly to the bottom line.

headline: GDXJ +7.4% TODAY, GDX +20% ON THE WEEK — Gold Mining Equities Break Out of Months-Long Selloff as Senior Margins Hit Record 68-70%
snippet: The VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ) surged 7.4% on August 12 and the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) gained more than 20% on the week to $89.73, as gold mining equities broke out of a months-long selloff that had compressed producer valuations even as gold rose from $3,800 to $4,400. Major producers captured the strongest absolute gains on the week: Agnico Eagle +22.9% in Toronto, Newmont +20.6%, Barrick +19.2%. The breakout is mechanically explained by operating leverage — at gold above $4,400/oz and AISC averaging $1,400–$1,600 for senior producers, the sector is generating free-cash-flow margins of 68–70%, the widest in recorded history. For TSX-V junior mining investors, the timing sequence matters: institutional capital historically flows first into senior producers (GDX) and mid-tier producers (GDXJ), then 3–6 months later cascades into junior explorers with quality drill programs. Today's senior and mid-tier breakout signals that sequence is advancing — junior gold and silver developers with funded 2026 programs and upcoming catalysts are typically the final and most levered beneficiaries of a re-rating that is now visibly underway at the senior level.

headline: PENTAGON BETS $400M ON WORLD'S FIRST PRIMARY SCANDIUM MINE — Sunrise Energy SRL Syerston NSW Surges 29%, Lockheed Offtake in Place
snippet: The U.S. Department of Defense announced a US$400 million conditional loan commitment to fund Sunrise Energy Metals' (ASX: SRL) Syerston project in New South Wales — which would be the world's first primary mine for scandium, a rare earth element critical to solid oxide fuel cells, aerospace aluminum-scandium alloys used in fighter jets and commercial aircraft, and next-generation battery electrodes. China controls approximately 70–80% of global scandium supply as a byproduct of titanium and iron ore processing; Syerston offers the only large, primary scandium deposit development outside Chinese-controlled supply chains. Sunrise struck a deal with Lockheed Martin last year to supply 25% of the mine's scandium output for the first five years, anchoring the defense demand vector; the DoD's $400M conditional loan — structured similarly to other critical mineral investments under Trump's executive orders targeting allied-nation supply diversification — adds the government-backed capital needed to reach a construction decision. SRL shares surged as much as 29% on the announcement, the largest single-day move in the company's history. For junior mining investors tracking government-funded critical mineral development, this confirms the US will finance mine-stage projects in Australian jurisdiction under the AUKUS and Minerals Security Partnership frameworks for materials where domestic sourcing is not feasible.

headline: TRINITY ZONE EXTENDS WEST: Apex APXC Drills 151m of 2.42% REO at Nebraska Carbonatite — NdPr-Rich, Strongest Grade-Width Intercept Yet
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Apex Critical Metals Corp. (CSE: APXC)
snippet: Apex Critical Metals Corp. (CSE: APXC) released August 12 results from four drill holes at the Rift Rare Earth Project within the Elk Creek Carbonatite Complex in southeastern Nebraska. Hole RIFT26-012, drilled 100 metres west of the discovery hole, returned 2.42% REO over 151.4 metres — the strongest grade-width intercept south of the discovery area and the longest continuous mineralized interval reported at the project — including 4.48% REO over 8.0 metres and 3.03% REO over 61.4 metres. Hole RIFT26-013 returned 5.27% REO over 10.2 metres. The REO mix carries elevated NdPr content, the magnetic rare earths with the highest demand growth trajectory from EV motors and direct-drive wind turbines. Results confirm the Trinity Zone is continuous, expanding westward and down-dip from the discovery area — one of the highest-grade carbonatite rare earth intersections in the contiguous United States. Elk Creek is one of only a handful of carbonatite complexes in the US, a geology type that produces the highest REO concentrations and the most amenable process chemistry for separation. US-hosted rare earth projects are increasingly eligible for DoD Direct Loan, EXIM Bank financing, and domestic supply preference under the 2024 CHIPS Act and 2025 Critical Minerals Acceleration Act — adding a government-backed financing pathway unavailable to projects in less strategically prioritized jurisdictions.

headline: FAULT-DISPLACED PORPHYRY EXTENSION? Kodiak KDK MPD BC Identifies 900m IP Anomaly Adjacent to South Deposit — 2026 Drill Program at Midpoint
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV: KDK)
snippet: Kodiak Copper Corp. (TSXV: KDK) reported August 12 that a 3D Induced Polarization survey at its fully-funded MPD copper-gold porphyry project in southern British Columbia identified a chargeability anomaly extending over 900 metres immediately adjacent to the current South Deposit mineral resource. The new 3D-IP anomaly is geometrically and geophysically similar to the anomaly associated with the South Deposit itself; available structural data suggests it represents a fault-displaced extension of the same porphyry system at depth — a parallel or offset lobe rather than a separate, unrelated target. Two diamond drill rigs are operating with 6,348 metres completed in 32 core holes to date against a 16,500-metre 2026 program (drilling continues into Q4 2026). An updated Mineral Resource Estimate is targeted for Q1 2027 incorporating all seven known MPD deposits. At copper above US$6.60/lb — itself at all-time highs driven by El Teniente suspension, DRC export bans, and tariff-driven inventory tightening — fault-offset porphyry targets adjacent to existing resources represent among the highest-reward discovery opportunities available in the exploration sector. If the 900m anomaly is confirmed by drilling to be a displaced extension of the South Deposit, MPD's total footprint and resource potential could increase materially ahead of the Q1 2027 MRE update.

headline: NEW ZEALAND FAST-TRACKS Gold-Antimony Mine at Reefton — RUA GOLD Scores Glamorgan Drill Permit in Same Six-Day Sweep
snippet: RUA Gold Inc. (TSX: RUA) announced August 11 that its Auld Creek Gold-Antimony Project in the Reefton Goldfield received Fast-Track designation under New Zealand's Fast-Track Approvals Act 2024 — confirming national significance and triggering a six-month expert panel permitting review that replaces the standard multi-year resource consent process. The proposed underground mine targets up to eight years of initial mine life, approximately 200 jobs, and an estimated NZ$240 million regional economic contribution; a Pre-Feasibility Study advances toward Q4 2026 completion with 800 community and stakeholder engagements documented. The same week, RUA received all required regulatory approvals to commence the first-ever exploration drilling of three priority targets at its Glamorgan epithermal gold project in the Hauraki Goldfield on New Zealand's North Island, adjacent to OceanaGold's Wharekirauponga deposit. Antimony was classified as a critical mineral by the US, UK, and EU following China's 2024 antimony export controls — a domestic New Zealand gold-antimony mine with fast-track permitting addresses a supply chain concern shared across all three Western blocs simultaneously. For retail mining investors evaluating jurisdiction risk, New Zealand's fast-track process, stable democratic governance, English-language legal system, and established Reefton goldfield infrastructure represent a low-political-risk path to production that sharply contrasts with the West African operating environments covered elsewhere today.

headline: AMERICA'S ONLY URANIUM MILL RAMPING: Energy Fuels White Mesa Expansion Accelerates Under Nuclear Push — Ute Mountain Tribe Raises Health Alarm
snippet: The push to quadruple U.S. nuclear energy capacity by 2050 — and a 2024 federal ban on Russian uranium imports effective 2028 — is driving increased throughput at the White Mesa Mill in Utah, the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill, operated by Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU). The federal government fast-tracked the adjacent Velvet-Wood uranium mine's environmental review in eleven days and gave the Ute Mountain Ute tribal community one week to provide comment, despite approximately 200 tribal members living within five miles of the mill facility. The White Mesa Mill's environmental impact on groundwater and air quality has been contested for decades; the accelerated permitting pace tied to the nuclear resurgence has intensified those concerns into what tribal leaders are describing as a public health alarm. For uranium sector investors, the story highlights the social license dimension of the US domestic uranium production thesis that is sometimes underweighted relative to spot price and utility contracting narratives. While the 2028 Russian ban deadline creates urgency favoring domestic ISR and conventional producers alike, community opposition at existing conventional mill operations — and the political attention it generates — could create a regulatory headwind for mill-dependent production growth while reinforcing the competitive position of ISR operators like Ur-Energy (TSX: URE) and enCore Energy whose production pathways do not depend on White Mesa's processing capacity.

headline: ED STEER: SILVER AND GOLD STOCKS UP 20%+ ON THE WEEK — Bullion Banks Step Aside as Six-Year Deficit Meets Rate Pivot and COT Compression
snippet: Ed Steer's August 9 market letter on GoldSeek documents the prior week's extraordinary performance in gold and silver equities — GDX, GDXJ, and the SIL silver miner ETF each gaining over 20% — and argues the commercial short-covering (bullion bank COMEX position unwind) that has historically capped precious metals rallies appears to have changed character ahead of today's CPI catalyst. Steer, who has tracked COMEX positioning via Commitment of Traders data for two decades, identifies commercial net short positions in gold and silver at or near multi-year lows before the rally began — removing the overhead suppression that triggered selloffs at key resistance levels in prior cycles. Combined with silver's sixth consecutive structural supply deficit (46.3 million ounce shortfall in 2026, the widest yet), fading rate-hike expectations, and China's January 2026 reclassification of silver as a strategic material on par with rare earths, Steer argues the current setup is 'the most bullish since 2020' — but with more durable fundamental support than the COVID-era rally. For retail investors trying to assess whether today's CPI-driven move is a tradeable spike or a durable trend change, Steer's COT-positioning lens provides a useful framework: when commercial hedgers are not heavily short, price advances tend to run farther and correct less sharply than in prior rallies that faced large speculative-versus-commercial imbalances.

headline: COPPERNICO COPR SOMBRERO PERU: EIA Approval Unlocks Major Drill Permit Expansion — Copper Porphyry Enters Systematic Drill Phase at $6.60/lb Copper
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Coppernico Metals Inc. (TSX: COPR)
snippet: Coppernico Metals Inc. (TSX: COPR) announced August 10 that its Peruvian subsidiary received approval of its Environmental Impact Assessment Semi-detailed study, unlocking a major expanded drill permit at the Sombrero copper-gold porphyry project in Peru — the principal regulatory hurdle that had constrained systematic drilling to the original permitted area. Peru is South America's second-largest copper producer and hosts globally significant copper porphyry systems including Las Bambas, Cerro Verde, and Constancia in the same geological belt where Sombrero is located. At copper above US$6.60/lb — itself approaching all-time highs driven by the El Teniente suspension, DRC concentrate export ban, and tariff-driven US inventory tightening — the market's appetite for early-stage porphyry drill programs in established copper belts has materially improved relative to the $4.50–5.00 environment that characterized 2022–2023 project economics. For junior copper investors, EIA approval for an expanded permit area is a concrete de-risking milestone that typically precedes 12–24 months of intensive systematic drilling — the phase that either identifies a resource foundation or rules out the concept — and which unlocks access to project financing conversations that were unavailable at the permit-pending stage.
